note: Command lines copied from SAOImageDS9's XPA reference, which is distributed under the GNU GPL, the same licence as this project. They are DS9's specification of its own access points and are used here as a conformance corpus. Regenerate with tools/import_ds9_xpa_examples.py.

set: movie 3d mpeg ds9.mpg number 10 az from -60 az to 60 oscillate 1
plot line xy.dat {The Title} {X Axis} {Y Axis} xy
plot title legend {This is the Legend}
prism plot RAWX RAWY PHA xyex
prism plot RAWX RAWY PHA PHI xyexey

get: region -format ds9 -system wcs -sky fk5 -skyformat sexagesimal -prop edit 1 -group foo
set: region group foo property delete no
